lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Catarina | Lesson 3 -- That Was Fun

listenings.text: Okay, so you will not believe my Saturday. We planned everything: the cinema, four o clock, the three of us. I left home at half past three and the bus never came. Never. I waited twenty-five minutes and then I walked. I arrived forty minutes late and the film had already started, so I did not go in. I sat outside and I felt so stupid. But then they came out, we walked to the pizza place, and honestly? That was the best part of the day. Anyway. What did you do?

Good morning. A quick word about last week's school trip. Sixty students went, and everything ran on time, which surprised all of us. In the morning we walked around the old town. In the afternoon we visited the museum and had lunch in the park. Nobody got lost, and nobody lost a phone, which is a first. Two students left jackets on the bus, so come and get them. And we still need the photos. Please send them before Friday. Thank you.

items.situation: It is Monday morning. A friend asks what you did. Answer with two things and one time expression.
Ask your teacher about her weekend. Two questions, both in the past.
Everyone went somewhere fun and you stayed home. Tell the story.
Tell me about the last time you had a great time. Where, who with, and why.
tips: We had a great time at ...

items.situation: Something was really easy for you recently. Say what it was.
tips: It was a piece of cake.
